detailed_descriptions.en: An online co-op game for 1-6 players where you fish with your friends to feed The One Fish! Catch fish of all shapes, sizes, and whimsical effects to keep up with its ever-growing appetite. The fun in fishing is never knowing what you might catch! From a harmless clownfish to an explosive bomb fish, you never know what's at the end of your line. All that matters is that you've caught enough to feed The One Fish and live to see another day... Some fish possess unique abilities that can affect you or all your friends. They can come in handy or become a huge pain in the fish, so keep an eye out for what you're pulling out of the water! Take a breather in chill mode! Explore a cozy little island alone or with friends and unwind.
